meaning:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.2; also called Raamiah at Neh.7.7;
Also named: ra.am.yah (רַעַמְיָה "Raamiah" H7485)
§ Reelaiah = "bearer of Jehovah"
1) one who returned from exile with Zerubbabel
1a) also 'Raamiah'
